items.title: Reflections of a reformed grammar Nazi
items.original_title: Reflections of a reformed grammar Nazi
items.rss_summary:
“Nothing bad can happen. It can only good happen.” Donald J. Trump
It would be easy to write off the regular word salads of America’s 47th president as the increasingly incoherent ramblings of an elderly man in obvious mental and physical decline.
However, one can also argue that Trump’s seemingly dyslexic struggles with the English language reflect a deliberate disregard for grammar rules that resonates with his support base. It’s the level of language that up to half of Americans happily use..
